name: Don't Ship the First AI Answer: 6-Step Verification Loop
description: A practical educational workflow for checking sources, calculations, constraints, risk, and review evidence before using AI-generated work.

step.name: Define The Task
step.text: Write the intended use, audience, required format, and acceptance criteria.

step.name: Check The Sources
step.text: Open the cited source, confirm it exists, and verify that it supports the claim.

step.name: Recompute The Numbers
step.text: Recalculate totals, percentages, dates, units, and conversions from the original inputs.

step.name: Test The Constraints
step.text: Check required fields, exclusions, policy boundaries, tone, and output format.

step.name: Review The Risk
step.text: Route higher-risk or irreversible decisions to an authorized human.

step.name: Record The Decision
step.text: Save the input, output, evidence, reviewer, decision, and date.
